test_lpr_event_selection_play_pause_scru.title: Selecting an event opens its clip player, and close ends it

steps.action: Click LPR in the left sidebar.
steps.expected: The LPR camera page opens and the event feed lists plate cards.

steps.action: Click the first event card.
steps.expected: The clip player opens with a video and a position readout such as 00:00 / 00:20.

steps.action: Click the close icon on the player.
steps.expected: The player closes and no video remains.

test_lpr_event_list_visibility.title: The live feed lists at least one event card

steps.action: Click LPR in the left sidebar.
steps.expected: The LPR camera page opens.

steps.action: Look at the event feed.
steps.expected: At least one event card shows a plate, a confidence, a camera, and a timestamp.

test_lpr_event_scrubber_control.title: The clip player shows its timeline readout and seek controls

steps.action: Click LPR in the left sidebar, then click the first event card in the feed.
steps.expected: The clip player opens with a video.

steps.action: Look at the player controls.
steps.expected: The player shows the position readout and the Backward and Forward seek icons.

steps.action: Click the close icon on the player.
steps.expected: The player closes.

test_lpr_event_filter_by_type.title: The feed filter opens with camera and duration options

steps.action: Click LPR in the left sidebar.
steps.expected: The LPR camera page opens.

steps.action: Click the Filter icon above the event feed.
steps.expected: The filter panel opens with Cameras and Duration sections and an Apply button.

test_lpr_event_timestamp_verification.title: Event cards carry a full time-and-date stamp

steps.action: Click LPR in the left sidebar.
steps.expected: The event feed lists at least one card.

steps.action: Read the timestamp line on the first card.
steps.expected: The line shows a time and a date, for example 1:37:38 AM | Aug 11 2026.

test_lpr_event_details_panel.title: The clip player exposes the event's action controls

steps.action: Click LPR in the left sidebar, then click the first event card in the feed.
steps.expected: The clip player opens with a video.

steps.action: Look at the action icons on the player.
steps.expected: The player shows Share, Export, and Create Link icons.

steps.action: Click the close icon on the player.
steps.expected: The player closes.

test_lpr_playback_speed_control.title: Speed control on the clip player (absent in the current UI)

steps.action: Click LPR in the left sidebar, then click the first event card in the feed.
steps.expected: The clip player opens with its position readout.

steps.action: Look for a playback speed control such as 1x.
steps.expected: No speed control is shown. The current player has none.

test_lpr_event_navigation_next_prev.title: The seek controls act on the open clip without breaking it

steps.action: Click LPR in the left sidebar, then click the first event card in the feed.
steps.expected: The clip player opens with a video.

steps.action: Click the Forward icon, then the Backward icon.
steps.expected: The video and the position readout stay visible.

steps.action: Click the close icon on the player.
steps.expected: The player closes.

test_lpr_fullscreen_event_playback.title: Fullscreen engages and releases on the clip player

steps.action: Click LPR in the left sidebar, then click the first event card in the feed.
steps.expected: The clip player opens with a video.

steps.action: Click the full screen icon.
steps.expected: The player fills the screen.

steps.action: Exit full screen.
steps.expected: The player returns to its inline size.

steps.action: Click the close icon on the player.
steps.expected: The player closes.
